verdict.rationale: Missive's pricing page lists "Email, SMS, social accounts" as channels. The API reference documents WhatsApp messages flowing through conversations, and the developer tools offer custom channels, so non-email channels share the team inbox alongside email. Evidence is mostly short marketing bullets and API notes, not in-depth channel docs. missing for 10: dedicated docs on SMS/WhatsApp/social setup in the shared inbox, any evidence of live chat support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
